note.after_visit_summary: Your diabetes is not at goal, with an A1c of 8.4%. You stopped glipizide because it caused low blood sugar, and you have not had lows since stopping it. Continue taking metformin 1000 mg twice daily with breakfast and dinner. Start empagliflozin 10 mg once daily in the morning. Drink plenty of water and keep your genital area clean while taking this medicine. If you get itching or a yeast infection, call the office. If you are sick and cannot eat or drink, skip empagliflozin that day. You need a diabetic eye exam; we have placed a referral and will send the details to your portal. Keep up your evening walks. We will repeat your A1c in 3 months and see you then.
